title: Reranker: precision regression harness for FP8/INT8 quant profiles
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: build a repeatable regression harness to validate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles for the reranker model family and ensure ranking quality (NDCG/MRR) stays within the allowed regression budget. This ticket covers dataset partitioning, calibration procedure automation, deterministic seeding, post-quant noise profiling, and the first pass of acceptance thresholds.

Scope:
- Implement calibration workflow standardization (per-layer scale saving, calibration seeds, minibatch jitter).
- Add a stratified holdout query set for stability checks: head/long-tail/rare intents.
- Add post-quant diagnostics: per-query delta logs, KL divergence of logits, and per-layer activation drift.
- Run baseline fp32 vs INT8 vs FP8 across three calibration strategies: static (min-max), KL-based, and dynamic per-batch scaling.
- Publish results to the eval dashboard and produce an artifacts bundle with calibration mats for reproducibility.

Non-goals: Retraining or weight clipping strategies (will be separate spike).

Why this is necessary: Recent customer reports show occasional top-1 mismatches after the INT8 rollout on small but critical enterprise corpora. We need an automated, auditable process that surfaces regressions early and ties them to calibration profile decisions so Platform/SEs can pick safe defaults for Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible harness (run script) that accepts model artifact, quant profile, and calibration recipe and emits NDCG@3,NDCG@10,MRR@1,MRR@5 with CI
Regression budget defined: max -0.5% absolute NDCG@10 or -1.0% relative MRR@1 compared to fp32 baseline (unless approved by PM)
Stored calibration metadata for each run (per-layer scales, calibration seed, minibatch order) saved to artifacts bucket and referenced in dashboard
Diagnostic pages added to internal dashboard: per-query delta sample, per-layer activation drift heatmap, and top-10 changed queries with diffs
Automation integrated with CI: any PR that changes quantization pipeline triggers the harness on a sampled commit and posts results to PR as a comment
test_plan: Create stratified eval splits from prod-query-v2 (head/medium/tail) and synthetic perturbation set for robustness checks.
Run fp32 baseline (deterministic seed 20260310) across all folds to compute baseline metrics.
Quantize with INT8 and FP8 using three calibration recipes; capture per-layer scales and store calibration vectors.
Compute NDCG@3, NDCG@10, MRR@1, MRR@5 and per-query delta; aggregate CI with bootstrapping (1000 resamples).
Run post-quant noise profiling: measure KL(logits_fp32 || logits_quant) and activation drift per-layer for failure analysis.
initial_results: Baseline fp32 (prod-query-v2): NDCG@10=0.6421, NDCG@3=0.6045, MRR@1=0.482, MRR@5=0.611
Notes: FP8 run shows regression beyond budget on tail queries; per-layer activation drift concentrated on layers 8-11.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Calibration nondeterminism across GPUs leading to flakiness. Mitigation: enforce deterministic seeding, pin cuDNN flags, and capture minibatch order in artifacts.
Risk: Small head queries mask tail regressions. Mitigation: require stratified reporting and separate pass for tail-focused thresholds.
Risk: CI cost explosion if full harness runs on every PR. Mitigation: sample commits for nightly full-run and fast path (smoke) on PRs using representative shard.
